payload.description:
Feature: Runtime GPT-5 controls

Scenario: Runtime configures agent model controls
Given a runtime has reasoning_effort and verbosity
When an agent configures its DSPy LM
Then both settings reach the LiteLLM request kwargs

Scenario: Runtime configures LLM-backed models
Given a ClassifyProcedure uses an LLMModel
When runtime reasoning_effort and verbosity are set
Then the LLM backend receives and forwards both settings

Scenario: Responses mode is used
Given model_type is responses
When verbosity is set
Then verbosity is sent as text.verbosity
payload.title: Propagate GPT-5 controls through Tactus runtime
